name: Old Grandpa Skinpack
summary: These are grandpas. It seems like there is more than just old stories behind those wrinkled smiles ...
legend: Nobody in the village remembers the grandpas arriving. They were just there one morning, sitting on the bench by the well as if they'd been waiting for a hundred years. Grandpa Herbert wears a teal shirt that looks a lot like someone else's, and he won't say where he got it. Grandpa Gunther strokes his thick grey beard and tells stories about strongholds that aren't on any map. Grandpa Friedrich just watches the horizon with pale blue eyes, like he's counting the sunsets he has left. At night their lanterns stay lit long after the villagers have gone to sleep. Sometimes you can hear them laughing about the old days, back before the first creeper ever hissed. Some people say they built this world. Others say they're still guarding something underneath it. Every winter, one more chair turns up by the fire...

skins.name: Grandpa Herbert
skins.story: Grandpa Herbert wears a teal shirt and purple trousers and swears he dressed like that before any hero ever spawned.

skins.name: Grandpa Clarence
skins.story: Grandpa Clarence has a bald head, grey tufts, a dark beard and a rust-brown shirt, and he remembers every block he ever mined.

skins.name: Grandpa Friedrich
skins.story: Grandpa Friedrich has bushy white hair, pale blue eyes and a green shirt, and he stares at the horizon like he's expecting someone.

skins.name: Grandpa Takeshi
skins.story: Grandpa Takeshi has thinning grey hair and a quiet olive-brown tunic, and he speaks rarely, but every word lands like a stone.

skins.name: Grandpa Gunther
skins.story: Grandpa Gunther strokes his great grey beard in his red shirt and tells tales of strongholds no map has ever shown.

versions.note: The first five grandpas take their seats by the village well: Herbert, Clarence, Friedrich, Takeshi and Guenther.

skins.name: Grandpa Gunter
skins.story: Grandpa Gunter has white hair, rosy cheeks and purple overalls with a teal collar, and he smiles like he knows your secrets.

skins.name: Grandpa Heinz
skins.story: Grandpa Heinz wears a brown jacket, grey trousers and a neat grey moustache, and he still walks the old roads every dawn.

skins.name: Grandpa Leopold
skins.story: Grandpa Leopold hides behind dark goggles and a full white beard, and his green robe with its golden collar smells of potions.

skins.name: Grandpa Walter
skins.story: Grandpa Walter shows up every winter in his red snowflake sweater, cheeks rosy, with presents nobody remembers wishing for.

versions.note: When winter came, four more chairs turned up by the fire. Gunter, Heinz, Leopold and Walter join the circle, bringing goggles, glasses and one very festive sweater.
versions.changelog:
## V1.1

4 new skins join the pack: Grandpa Gunter, Grandpa Heinz, Grandpa Leopold and Grandpa Walter.

When winter came, four more chairs turned up by the fire. Gunter, Heinz, Leopold and Walter join the circle, bringing goggles, glasses and one very festive sweater.

New skins:
- **Grandpa Gunter** — Grandpa Gunter has white hair, rosy cheeks and purple overalls with a teal collar, and he smiles like he knows your secrets.
- **Grandpa Heinz** — Grandpa Heinz wears a brown jacket, grey trousers and a neat grey moustache, and he still walks the old roads every dawn.
- **Grandpa Leopold** — Grandpa Leopold hides behind dark goggles and a full white beard, and his green robe with its golden collar smells of potions.
- **Grandpa Walter** — Grandpa Walter shows up every winter in his red snowflake sweater, cheeks rosy, with presents nobody remembers wishing for.

This download contains all 9 skins of the pack, so new players get everything in one file.

![V1.1 skins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Busja777/minecraft-mod-factory/main/data/skins/old-grandpa-skinpack/media/v1.1-skins.png)

versions.title: The Hobby Bench

skins.name: Grandpa Bernard
skins.story: Grandpa Bernard wears a bucket hat full of fishing lures and a vest with a pocket for every bait, and the fish he caught grows a little bigger every time he tells it.

skins.name: Grandpa Alfredo
skins.story: Grandpa Alfredo grows the biggest tomatoes in the village under his wide straw hat, and his green apron always has one more seed packet in the pocket for you.

skins.name: Grandpa Desmond
skins.story: Grandpa Desmond keeps a pencil behind his ear and sawdust in his white beard, and every chair around the well was built by his hands.

versions.note: Spring brings three more grandpas to the bench by the well, and every one of them brought his hobby along: a fishing rod, a garden trowel and a carpenter's pencil.

versions.title: Sunday Best

skins.name: Grandpa Archibald
skins.story: Grandpa Archibald peers through round glasses from under his tweed cap, straightens his red bow tie and corrects your grammar with the kindest smile in the village.

skins.name: Grandpa Ramon
skins.story: Grandpa Ramon came back from the seaside with a sunburnt head, dark sunglasses and a flower shirt, and he has refused to wear long trousers ever since.

skins.name: Grandpa Seamus
skins.story: Grandpa Seamus keeps watch over the village at night in his old navy peacoat and knitted cap, and the little lantern at his hip has never once gone out.

versions.note: On Sundays the grandpas dress up for the village: one in tweed and a bow tie, one in a flower shirt straight from the seaside, and one in his old navy peacoat with a lantern at his hip.
